findings.originalProbe: Error message and final logger retained a structured secret canary.
findings.postFixProbe: Structured assignment variants are redacted in error, cause, metadata, and final logger boundaries.

findings.originalProbe: 25 handlers remained active after timeout responses and after application close resolved.
findings.postFixProbe: Close waits for tracked handler settlement; deadline expiry records FAILED, omits api.stopped, and exits non-zero.

findings.originalProbe: Unknown applied version and modified down SQL were accepted.
findings.postFixProbe: Unknown, missing, gapped, incomplete, up-drift, and down-drift histories fail; valid prefix/no-op/down/up and exact legacy upgrade pass.

findings.originalProbe: Package/deep app imports and aliased process access produced no architecture violations.
findings.postFixProbe: Package, deep, relative, re-export, dynamic import, global/local alias, and destructuring fixtures are rejected; real graph passes.

findings.originalProbe: Production PostgreSQL without TLS parsed successfully.
findings.postFixProbe: Staging/production require verify-full, conflicting URL SSL parameters fail, and pg clients receive rejectUnauthorized=true.

findings.originalProbe: Runtime authenticated as an administrator and SET ROLE restored DDL authority.
findings.postFixProbe: Runtime authenticates as an independent restricted login; DDL, administrator SET ROLE, role alteration/drop, and grant escalation are denied.

findings.originalProbe: Contradictory processing/pending rows and runtime DELETE were accepted.
findings.postFixProbe: Four coherent states pass, contradictory states fail, and runtime DELETE is denied.

findings.originalProbe: Enumerable getter ran and its exception escaped the sanitizer.
findings.postFixProbe: Getter and Proxy traps do not escape or expose values; final logger emits fixed safe markers.

findings.originalProbe: 0 of 25 timeout failure and completion records had request/correlation IDs.
findings.postFixProbe: 25 of 25 concurrent timeout responses, failure logs, and completion logs retain their exact unique request/correlation pair with no cross-bleed.

findings.originalProbe: Hosted evidence reported one Moderate advisory without identity or assessment.
findings.postFixProbe: GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq was identified, recorded, dispositioned FIX, and removed by uuid 11.1.1; post-fix audit reports zero advisories.

findings.originalProbe: Any git log error, including the 20 MiB buffer limit, was treated as empty history.
findings.postFixProbe: No-history is explicit, Git failures fail closed, clean history over 20 MiB streams successfully, and a historical canary fails the scan.
